result.summary: The page layout is mostly coherent, but there are several visual defects: a truncated restaurant title colliding with its rating, clipped card text in the horizontal carousel with no ellipsis affordance, inconsistent favorite-button styling between cards, and a thumbnail whose treatment does not match its siblings.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen' title is cut off mid-character and runs into the star rating / '4.8 (500+)' block on the same row, with no ellipsis or gap between them.
issues.suggestion: Give the title a flexible width with min-width 0 and text-overflow: ellipsis, and reserve fixed space for the rating so the two never overlap.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…', '€1.90 delivery') is hard-clipped at the screen edge, making it ambiguous whether the row is scrollable or simply broken.
issues.suggestion: Add a peek offset/partial card with consistent gutter padding, plus an edge fade or paging indicator to signal horizontal scroll; truncate the label with an ellipsis.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background, border and icon color across all cards, using a single component with one contrast-safe treatment over imagery.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the sibling thumbnails are dark, so its white '15–25 min' time badge has very low contrast and the card looks unfinished/placeholder-like.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image treatment (dark gradient scrim) behind time badges, or use a darker text/badge variant on light imagery.

issues.description: The category chip row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy, …') is cut at the right edge with a barely visible sliver of the next chip, giving the impression of clipped rather than scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: Increase the peek of the next chip and add horizontal scroll padding/fade so scrollability is obvious.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20%) is truncated by the bottom tab bar with no name or metadata visible, so the list ends abruptly with no scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.
